policies.sdk-foundation: Compose installed UI SDK behaviors and public React parts. Keep aliases unchanged and pins matched.
policies.shared-state: A person and runtime agent use the same state and callbacks. Read the outcome after controlled acceptance; dispatch success alone is insufficient.
policies.semantic-controls: Give every task control a stable meaning and accessible name. Use actual SDK components or documented definePrimitive, not painted or intrinsic interaction replicas.
policies.proof-boundary: This is a static authoring/routing inventory. Test paths identify intended evidence scope, not pass status for an arbitrary release. Custom visuals remain Unvalidated; no human usability or accessibility-conformance certification is implied.
